notes:
Overview:
- Mid-market SaaS (customer support product) building hosted chat agents + agent assist UI.
- Primary goal: fast interactive chat for support reps and end-users (streaming required).
- Strong interest in starting on Redwood Hosted API for speed-to-value; likely move to Dedicated for predictable latency and committed pricing after POC.

POC details / technical requirements:
- Workload: live chat + background summarization and context retrieval (embeddings + reranking).
- Latency SLO: <1.5s first-token for interactive flows (goal applied to p50/p95 depending on route); firm request from product/ops.
- Streaming + tool-calling: must support streaming partial tokens and calling internal tools (ticket create, KB lookup).
- Concurrency: expect 150-250 concurrent agent sessions during peak; avg session length ~8-12 minutes.
- Payloads: typical prompt window ~1k tokens; tool outputs small (100-400 tokens).
- Model preference: open to Redwood-curated 7B-70B families; wants options for quantized variants for cost.

Security / compliance:
- Must integrate with SSO (SAML) and support audit logs for agent actions.
- KMS integration required for encryption at rest of logs/keys.
- Data residency discussion: primary US, Europe later.

POC findings so far:
- Hosted API POC shows median first-token ~1.2s (us-east), p95 ~2.1s. Streaming works; tool calls have slight extra latency (~200-300ms).
- Customer says: "If we can't get p95 under 1.5s with streaming enabled we will push for Dedicated or edge routing."
- SE notes: KV caching and prefix caching reduces tokens for repeat agent prompts; batching helps cost but can hurt first-token latency.

Commercials / next steps:
- Short-term: finish hosted API POC (2 weeks) with tighter routing and kernel tweaks; capture synthetic and real-agent metrics across regions.
- If SLOs met, customer requests proposal for Dedicated reserved capacity + burst. Wants committed pricing band + SLA.
- Security: provide SOC2 docs, answer questionnaire (due 2026-03-15).
- AE to run pricing scenario with finance and provide ARR estimate for commitments.

Quotes / customer color:
- "We need streaming that feels instantaneous to agents — any lag kills adoption." — Head of Product
- "Willing to commit if latency and costs are predictable." — VP Ops

Open questions for Redwood team:
- Can Dedicated meet p95 <1.5s at target concurrency with streaming+tool-calls? Need benchmark guidance.
- Recommended model families and quantization profiles for this workload?
- Suggested autoscaling/burst config to protect latency under spikes.

Short action items:
- SE to run high-concurrency benchmark (Diego) and share results by 2026-03-12.
- AE (Maya) to send committed pricing template and draft SOW.
- Security to provide SOC2 summary and KMS integration notes.
